description: ASW optimistic fair exchange (de-probabilised, after Islam-Zaid, IJNS 2008, 'Probabilistic Analysis of the ASW Protocol Using PRISM'). The honest party (coalition) has a strategy -- wait to receive before committing, else invoke the trusted third party -- keeping fairness forever: never a state where it released its signature but holds nothing -> expected TRUE. This matches the paper's finding that fairness holds (Pmax[F advantaged state] = 0). Qualitative core of the fair-exchange guarantee; abstracts the timeout/timeliness and effectiveness analysis.
